layers.description: Llims argilosos amb graves cohesives de coloració marronosa. Graves incloses en matriu sorrenca d'aspectes carbonatats, i de coloracions clares. Tram totalment carbonatat.
layers.note: The 'Unitat litològica' column shows a single NIVELL 1 spanning the entire logged depth (0.0 to 8.0 m). The description combines multiple sub-descriptions visible in the graphic column but all belong to the same geological level. Total depth read as 8.0 m based on the depth scale visible on the log; the borehole column extends to the 8.0 m tick mark.

spt_results.note: Four blow counts visible: 24, 14, 28, 30. N_SPT = 14+28+30 = 72 if standard (last 3 increments of 15 cm), but the column shows values 24/14/28/30 across four rows which may represent 4 × 15 cm increments. N_SPT computed as sum of last three increments (14+28+30 = 72) OR as sum of all blows depending on convention. Confidence reduced due to ambiguity in reading blow sequence. The depth_from and depth_to are read as -1.00 to -1.60 m (extraction depth per log). N_SPT value of 42 noted in original template example — recomputed here: blows [24,14,28,30], N_SPT = 28+30 = 58 (last two 15 cm increments if 4 rows) or 14+28+30 = 72 (last three). Value is uncertain; raw blows provided for human review.

sondeig_tests.extraction_notes: Water level (N.F.) not indicated on the log. The 'Nivell freàtic' column appears blank. The borehole graphic column shows a hatched/dotted pattern consistent with gravelly silty material throughout. The log depth scale runs to at least 8.0 m but the described material and column detail are concentrated in the upper ~1.8 m (SPT zone); below that the column is largely blank/unfilled suggesting the borehole may have been logged to 8.0 m with no further material change noted or the log sheet template extends to 8.0 m by default. SPT blow counts read from the 'Registre' column as four values: 24, 14, 28, 30. UTM X and Y coordinates not filled in on the document (blank fields). Z elevation = 199.50 m.

extraction_notes: Formatted vectorial PDF borehole log (Sondeig a rotació amb bateria contínua). Document is in good condition and clearly printed.
